items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: (To the question) As in the adjacent answer: the raising of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima comes to their place only at the time that the coupling and the Ibur are made in the place of the GAR of Atik, see there.
